select tmp.acctSubjectType, tmp.portfolioId , tmp.portfolioName, tmp.finprodId, tmp.prodId, tmp.channelId, tmp.channelName, tmp.payType, #{taxClass} taxClass, DATE_FORMAT(max(tmp.mdate),'%Y-%m-%d') taxStartDate, sum(case when tmp.fee_type = #{TAX0102} then tmp.tdy_unpaid_intincexp else 0 end) interestIncome, /*利息收入*/ sum(case when tmp.fee_type = #{TAX0202} then tmp.tdy_unpaid_intincexp else 0 end) dividendIncome, /*红利收入*/ sum(case when tmp.fee_type = #{TAX0302} then tmp.tdy_unpaid_intincexp else 0 end) difbetIncome, /*价差收入*/ sum(case when tmp.fee_type = #{ALT0102} then tmp.tdy_unpaid_intincexp else 0 end) constructionTax, sum(case when tmp.fee_type = #{ALT0202} then tmp.tdy_unpaid_intincexp else 0 end) educationTax, sum(case when tmp.fee_type = #{ALT0302} then tmp.tdy_unpaid_intincexp else 0 end) placeeducationTax, sum(case when tmp.fee_type = #{ALT0402} then tmp.tdy_unpaid_intincexp else 0 end) waterTrafficTax, sum(tmp.tdy_unpaid_intincexp) taxTotal, /*税费总额*/ CONCAT_WS(ifnull(null,''), DATE_FORMAT(#{payment1}, '%Y') , '年' , trunc((DATE_FORMAT(#{payment1}, '%m') + 2) / 3) , '季度销项税金结转金额:' , cast(sum(tmp.tdy_unpaid_intincexp) as decimal(12,4) ) ) remark /*交易备注*/ from ( select case when bok.acct_subject_type = #{FINPROD_TYPE_F18} then ptl.portfolio_id when bok.acct_subject_type = #{FINPROD_TYPE_F16} then ad.portfolio_id end portfolioId, case when bok.acct_subject_type = #{FINPROD_TYPE_F18} then ptl.portfolio_name when bok.acct_subject_type = #{FINPROD_TYPE_F16} then (select ptl1.portfolio_name from ptl_portfolio ptl1 where ad.portfolio_id = ptl1.portfolio_id) end portfolioName, ptl.profit_type, bok.acct_subject_type acctSubjectType, fee.finprod_id finprodId, bok.acct_subject_id prodId, fin1.finprod_market_id channelId, fin1.finprod_abbr channelName, ad1.pay_type payType, IFNULL(deal.mdate + 1,fin.vdate) mdate, fee.fee_type, fee.branch, fee.tdy_unpaid_intincexp
from bok_position_prdfee fee left join bok_bookset bok on fee.finprod_id = bok.acct_subject_id left join ptl_portfolio ptl on ptl.portfolio_id = fee.finprod_id left join FIN_PRODUCT fin on fin.finprod_id = fee.finprod_id left join fin_product_add ad on fee.finprod_id = ad.finprod_id left join FIN_PRODUCT fin1 on fin1.finprod_id = fee.chl_id left join fin_product_add ad1 on fin1.finprod_id = ad1.finprod_id left join trd_product_deal deal on deal.finprod_id = bok.acct_subject_id and deal.chl_id = fee.chl_id and deal.busi_type = #{BUSI_TYPE_16} and deal.ps = #{taxidenType} and deal.trade_status = #{TRADE_STATUS_01} and deal.is_cancel = #{YES_NO_NO} and deal.mdate <= #{payment1} where 1=1 and fee.CDATE = (#{payment1}-1) and fin1.finprod_market_id = #{channelId} and fee.tdy_unpaid_intincexp != 0 and fee.fee_type in (#{TAX0102},#{TAX0202},#{TAX0302},#{ALT0102},#{ALT0202},#{ALT0302},#{ALT0402}) and not exists ( select * from trd_product_deal deal1 where deal1.finprod_id = bok.acct_subject_id and deal1.chl_id = fee.chl_id and deal1.busi_type = #{BUSI_TYPE_16} and deal1.ps = #{taxidenType} and deal1.trade_status = #{TRADE_STATUS_01} and deal1.is_cancel = #{YES_NO_NO} and deal1.mdate = #{payment1} ) ) tmp group by portfolioId,portfolioName,finprodId,prodId,channelId, channelName,payType,acctSubjectType

select tmp.portfolioId portfolioId, DATE_FORMAT(max(seitleDate), '%Y-%m-%d ') payTaxVDate,fp.profit_type as profitType from (select bba.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId,bba.cdate seitleDate from PTL_FEE_POSITION bba where 1=1
and bba.PORTFOLIO_ID in
#{item}
and bba.PTL_FEE_TYPE in (#{TAX0302}, #{TAX0202}, #{TAX0102}, #{ALT0102}, #{ALT0202}, #{ALT0302}, #{ALT0402}) union all select fpa.portfolio_id portfolioId, bba.cdate seitleDate from BOK_POSITION_PRDFEE bba left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpa on (bba.finprod_id = fpa.finprod_id or bba.finprod_id = fpa.portfolio_id) where 1=1
and bba.finprod_id in
#{item}
and bba.FEE_TYPE in (#{TAX0302}, #{TAX0202}, #{TAX0102}, #{ALT0102}, #{ALT0202}, #{ALT0302}, #{ALT0402})) tmp left join fin_product fp on tmp.portfolioId=fp.finprod_market_id group by tmp.portfolioId,fp.profit_type
